items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: she got to be the star of The Me That Nobody Knows and Me and Bessie... and of course Alberta Hunter; she did very well.

ctx.x: I got into London June 30. I stayed all of July in England, all over England and went to France in August.
I got a picture of Alberta singing with you in France.
One of the dog gonest things that happened--

items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Now, was this when Snub Mosley's band was with you. ... after the European tour, then I think is when Snub Moseley came in.

ctx.x: Oh, gosh, we were gone so long. I don't remember how long. And after we finished that, we came right back.
